statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Nasdaq weakness extended through early afternoon while Treasury yields, volatility, oil, and several major technology shares remained aligned with downside pressure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES; current Tail remains elevated because the downside path has persisted from a near-flat open alongside firmer yields, volatility, and oil, while incomplete direct NQ retracement detail limits the one-way-path assessment.
headline: Elevated Tail persists as Nasdaq extends lower with Treasury yields near 5.10%.
body: Near the cutoff, the Nasdaq Composite was about 1.2% lower and December NQ about 0.9% lower, versus a near-flat Nasdaq cash open. The 10-year Treasury yield was near 5.10%, VIX near 14.95, and Brent above $102. The aligned pressure supports elevated Tail, but direct live NQ pullback quality remains incomplete.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail was mostly low before moving to WATCH at 14:00 UTC and elevated at 15:00–16:00 UTC as the U.S. rates-led decline persisted.
outlookSummary: Tail is elevated while the afternoon decline remains efficient alongside Treasury yields near cycle highs and firmer volatility and oil. Meaningful two-way retracement or easing cross-asset pressure would reduce Tail; renewed extension with failed pullbacks would keep the danger window active.

Normal conditions prevail if cross-asset pressure stabilizes. A renewed yield spike plus directional NQ extension and failed retracements would raise Tail.
